### axiosClient.refreshSession() ⇒ <code>Promise.&lt;Object&gt;</code>
Serialize refreshes within a tab and, where supported, across browser tabs.
No credential is stored in cross-tab storage or messages.

**Kind**: static method of [<code>axiosClient</code>](#api.module_axiosClient)
**Returns**: <code>Promise.&lt;Object&gt;</code> - Fresh session payload.
